test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
solution:
The correct answer is '**acquire**' (option 3).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the result of constant endeavour through thought, word, and deed.
 
• The word "acquire" appropriately matches the idea of gaining or achieving something, fitting the context of achieving absolute peace of mind.
 
• Other options ("**scatter**,” "**forfeit**,” and "**divide**”) do not convey the idea of attaining or achieving peace of mind.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *We should remember that all religions (1) preach__ good conduct in life, the foundation of which should rest on (2) __ethics__. Without the basis of morality, philosophy would remain mere polemics, and religion would be (3) __meaningless__ and vain. Nobody can say that he is religious unless he is (4) __truthful__ and unselfish. It is realised that by constant endeavour through thought, word and deed, one could (5) __acquire__ absolute peace of mind.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Scatter**: This does not fit the context of achieving peace of mind.
 
• **Forfeit**: This does not fit the context of achieving peace of mind.
 
• **Divide**: This does not fit the context of achieving peace of mind.
